name: Balor HCH Helmet Crusader Edition
description:
Item Type: Heavy Armor
Damage Reduction: 40%
Temp. Rating: -75 / 105 °C
Radiation Protection: 26800 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s

Every piece of the Balor was designed by Clark Defense Systems to more evenly distribute damage. This spreads the force of an impact across the heavy helmet, helping it hold up when others would fail. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for the company's security services. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.
